name: Heth
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Rebekah sent Jacob to Laban her brother until Esau's fury turned away, and said she was weary of her life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me? Marrying the sons and daughters within the kindred is a weighty matter to the mothers of Israel.

Esau, who is Edom, took wives of the daughters of Canaan, Hittite and Hivite, against his parents, and when they were angry he married Bashemath, Ishmael's daughter, which was still bad; that is why so many light-skinned Arabs are Esau, and Nebajoth's line became the Nabataeans.

note.label: Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present

points: Jacob charged them to bury him with his fathers in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace, where Abraham and Sarah, Isaac and Rebekah, and Leah lie buried.

note.label: Genesis 49: What Shall Befall the Twelve Tribes in the Last Days

points: The kings on this side Jordan, in the hills, in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon: the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite. These are Hamites, better known as Nilotic Africans.

note.label: Joshua 9: The Gibeonite Deception and the Weight of an Oath

points: David asked Ahimelech the Hittite and Abishai the son of Zeruiah, the brother of Joab, Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp? and Abishai said, I will go down with thee; and they came to the people by night, and all lay sleeping.

note.label: 1 Samuel 26: David Spares Saul a Second Time

points: And David sent and enquired after the woman. And one said, Is not this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?

And one said, Is not this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite? Somebody with a spiritual mind made it clear: this is somebody's wife. And David sent messengers, and took her anyway. Wisdom and understanding were right there, and he ignored them.

In the morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah, ordering that Uriah be set in the forefront of the hottest battle and then abandoned, that he might be smitten and die. Joab assigned Uriah to a place where he knew valiant men were, and when the men of the city fought, some of David's servants fell, and Uriah the Hittite died also.

note.label: 2 Samuel 11: David, Bathsheba, and the Murder of Uriah

points: Yet for David's sake the Most High gives him a lamp in Jerusalem, because David did right all his days save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite, a wrong from which David repented.

note.label: 1 Kings 15: Abijam, Asa, Nadab, and Baasha

points: The word of the Most High came to Ezekiel to cause Jerusalem to know her abominations: her birth and nativity is of the land of Canaan, her father an Amorite and her mother a Hittite.

note.label: Ezekiel 16: The Harlot Redeemed by an Everlasting Covenant
